method: Unified adjustment framework (provisional): use the same xG-delta mechanism for every team, while setting the delta magnitude individually by player role, confirmed absence status, recent involvement/minutes, replacement depth, and team context. Attack/creation absences reduce the absent team's own xG; defensive/goalkeeper absences increase the opponent's xG. Do not mix arbitrary adjustment mechanisms or apply a universal per-player delta. If role/availability/impact is uncertain, record it without numeric adjustment. Current round's numeric deltas remain conservative manual heuristics, not fitted player-value estimates; no retrospective claim of calibration. V1 recalculates Poisson probabilities from adjusted xG. V2 blends revised Poisson 30% with the pre-existing official market vote share 70%. Latest 2026-10-31 09:12 JST audit: Mito's five official injury announcements were reviewed; 10/30 third-party availability changes were tracked, but no numeric adjustment was added because match-specific availability was not officially confirmed. The 08:35 JST official toto vote snapshot was verified and is already the snapshot used in V2.

adjustmentPolicy.commonMechanism: All confirmed absence adjustments are expressed through homeExpectedGoalsDelta and/or awayExpectedGoalsDelta before probability calculation.

roleMapping.attacking_or_chance_creation: Reduce the absent team's own expected goals.
roleMapping.two_way_or_unclear_role: Assess the player's primary role and evidence; if impact direction cannot be supported, do not apply a numeric adjustment.

adjustmentPolicy.individualizedMagnitude: Set the magnitude by role, verified absence duration/status, recent appearances and minutes, replacement quality/depth, and team context. Do not use one fixed delta for all teams or players.
adjustmentPolicy.uncertainty: Unconfirmed injuries, expected lineups, and uncertain return status are tracked but receive no numeric adjustment until verified.
adjustmentPolicy.calibration: Treat manual deltas as provisional heuristics. Store the rationale and source; calibrate magnitudes only through historical/out-of-sample validation.
adjustmentPolicy.timing: Official starting lineups are a separate final pre-kickoff update and must not be conflated with this interim team-news revision.
